seoTitle: How to Create a Supplemental Feed with Google Sheets
metaDescription: Build a supplemental Google Sheets feed for Google Merchant Center to fix disapproved listings and update titles or labels without touching your core feed.
intro: Fixing disapproved products or updating specific attributes in your Google Shopping inventory doesn't have to mean editing your core website feed. A supplemental data source, built as a synced Google Sheet, lets you match items by product ID and override specific fields. This guide covers setting it up in Merchant Center Next.

steps.heading: Enable advanced data source management
steps.body: In Merchant Center Next, turn on advanced data source management to access supplemental feed options.

steps.heading: Structure your Google Sheet
steps.body: Set up matching product IDs alongside the custom attributes you want to add or override.

steps.heading: Add labels and title overrides
steps.body: Include custom labels or corrected titles in your spreadsheet for the specific products you need to update.

steps.heading: Connect the spreadsheet as a data source
steps.body: Authenticate Google Drive access and link your spreadsheet inside the Merchant Center dashboard.

steps.heading: Map attributes to your primary feed
steps.body: Link the new supplemental data layer directly to your primary product feed so it knows which fields to override.

steps.heading: Set a fetch schedule and verify
steps.body: Configure a scheduled fetch frequency, then check the Diagnostics tab to confirm your product updates processed correctly.

faq.question: Do I need to edit my website's core product feed?
faq.answer: No, the entire point of a supplemental feed is to override or add specific attributes without touching your core website feed.

faq.question: How does Google Sheets know which product to update?
faq.answer: You match items using the unique primary product ID in your spreadsheet, which links each row to the corresponding product in your main feed.

faq.question: Can this help fix disapproved products?
faq.answer: Yes, a supplemental feed is commonly used to correct attributes that are causing disapprovals, such as titles or missing details.

faq.question: Will the feed update automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set a scheduled fetch frequency so Merchant Center pulls updated data from your spreadsheet on a regular basis.
